parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified architecture functionally: the TPS2121 power mux, AP63203WU buck, TPS1H200 high-side heater switch, ESP32-C3, three MAX31855 thermocouple channels, USB-C/CC pulldowns, fan-tach TVS protection, and heater status LED are all present with the expected values and connectivity. Reference designators differ from the specification, but no electrical deviation from the intended design is supported by the netlist.
